name: Driveway & Patio Sealing
shortDescription: Professional sealing for driveways and patios — protect your investment from weather, oil, and freeze-thaw damage.
description: At London Concrete Sealing, we understand that your driveway is not just a practical space — it's also a significant component of your home's curb appeal. Our professional driveway and patio sealing service uses high-quality sealants to provide durable protection against the elements, ensuring your concrete remains in excellent condition year after year.
benefits: Extended lifespan — protective layer guards against water, oil spills, and freeze-thaw damage
Improved appearance — rich colour and smooth finish boosts curb appeal
Stain resistance — easier to clean and resists oil and grease
Eco-friendly sealants safe for family and pets
Variety of finishes: matte, semi-gloss, and high-gloss

process.detail: We thoroughly clean the driveway to remove dirt, debris, and existing stains for optimal sealant adherence.
Any cracks or damages are repaired to create a smooth, uniform surface and prevent further deterioration.
Our professionals apply a high-quality sealant designed for driveways, providing durable protection and an enhanced finish.
We allow sufficient time for the sealant to dry and cure, ensuring it bonds properly for long-lasting protection.

name: Concrete Sealing
shortDescription: Expert concrete sealing for all surfaces — patios, walkways, garage floors, pool decks, and more.
description: Our concrete sealing service uses top-of-the-line sealants to protect all concrete surfaces from the elements, stains, and daily wear. Whether it's a patio, walkway, garage floor, or pool deck, we have the right solution to extend the life and enhance the appearance of your concrete.
benefits: Protects against moisture, stains, and environmental damage

process.detail: We assess the condition of your concrete surface and recommend the most suitable sealing solution.
Professional pressure washing removes all dirt, mildew, and contaminants before sealing.
Even, professional-grade sealant application ensures complete coverage and deep penetration.
We inspect the finished surface to ensure a uniform, high-quality seal.

name: Concrete Driveway Installation
shortDescription: Full concrete driveway installation — remove the old, pour new. Patios and walkways included.
description: Expert concrete driveway installation services from start to finish. We handle everything from removing your old driveway to pouring and finishing the new concrete. Our team can also install concrete patios, walkways, and other hardscaping features to transform your outdoor space.
benefits: Complete removal of old driveway included

process.detail: Removal of existing materials, proper grading, and sub-base preparation for a stable foundation.
Precise forms are set to ensure clean edges and correct dimensions throughout your project.
High-quality concrete is poured and levelled for a flat, even surface.
Surface finishing to your chosen texture, followed by a proper curing period for maximum strength.

name: Stamped Concrete Sealing
shortDescription: Preserve the colour and pattern of your stamped concrete with specialized sealing.
description: Stamped concrete adds a decorative element to your surfaces but requires protection to maintain its look. Our stamped concrete sealing service enhances the colour and design while providing a durable, protective layer that guards against fading, weathering, and wear.
benefits: Enhances the depth of decorative patterns
Available in gloss, satin, and matte finishes
Extends the life of your investment

process.detail: We assess the current condition of your stamped concrete and identify any repairs needed.
Old sealant is stripped when resealing to ensure proper adhesion of the new coat.
Thorough cleaning removes dirt, algae, and contaminants embedded in the pattern.
Thin coat application of specialized stamped concrete sealer for optimal colour enhancement and protection.

name: Concrete Finishes
shortDescription: Custom concrete finishes including broom, exposed aggregate, polished, and stained options.
description: Enhance your concrete surfaces with a variety of professional finishes that combine beauty and function. From classic broom finishes to decorative exposed aggregate and polished options, we can customize the look of your concrete to complement your property.
benefits: Suitable for driveways, patios, pool decks, and walkways

finishTypes.name: Broom Finish
finishTypes.description: Classic textured finish for driveways and sidewalks — slip-resistant and durable.

finishTypes.name: Exposed Aggregate
finishTypes.description: Stone and pebble surface revealed through washing — decorative and long-lasting.

finishTypes.name: Polished Concrete
finishTypes.description: Smooth, glossy finish ideal for patios and interior floors.

finishTypes.name: Stamped
finishTypes.description: Patterns mimicking brick, stone, or tile for a decorative outdoor surface.

finishTypes.name: Stained
finishTypes.description: Colour stains that penetrate the surface for rich, lasting hues.

process.detail: We discuss finish options and help you select the best choice for your project.
Proper preparation ensures the finish adheres correctly and performs well.
Skilled application of the chosen finish technique.
A protective sealant is applied to preserve the finish and extend its lifespan.
